text:
Joanne: quick ping — can someone eyeball PR #2893? Adds adaptive KV cache eviction + quantized kernel selector. Trying to catch any perf regressions or cost regressions before EOD. https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/2893 :eyes:
Rahul: on it, can you paste the perf numbers you saw locally?
Joanne: ran small bench (p50/p95) on T4: p50 ~ 45ms (same), p95 up 10% on long-context workloads. Token cost estimate up ~2% due to less batching in a corner case.
Nick: odd — the eviction policy change could increase KV misses for long prefix reuse. I'll scan the logic.
ci-bot: build #6012 passed — unit tests + integration smoke ✅
Maria: I can run the perf harness on a larger trace this afternoon, want me to run the 100k-token trace from prod-sample?
Joanne: yes please, that would be helpful. Also note the PR toggles quantized kernel only for seq_len>2k in code.
Nick: quick glance: in cache_eviction.py the threshold calc uses int(math.ceil(...)) — off-by-one might cause earlier evictions. Suggest switching to floor and add unit test.
Rahul: good catch. @Nick can you open a small follow-up or annotate the PR? If it's low risk we can bump to canary.
Nick: adding a commit with test + fix now.
Tim: what's the desired merge window? If Maria's larger trace looks OK, can we merge before tomorrow's deploy window? :calendar:
Joanne: prefer before 17:00 PST tomorrow. If any red flags, we'll hold. :thumbsup:
Maria: started the run, will post results here once done. ETA ~50m.
Joanne: thanks — tagging @eng-runtime for visibility.
